---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
career_home_runs <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast),
    by = "playerID"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  mutate(
    player = str_c(nameFirst, nameLast, sep = " ")
  ) |>
  select(player, career_home_runs, first_year, last_year)

career_home_runs |>
  mutate(
    steroid_era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Career overlapped steroid era",
      "Career did not overlap steroid era"
    ),
    player = fct_reorder(player, career_home_runs)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = career_home_runs, y = player, fill = steroid_era)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Career Home Runs of the Top 15 Sluggers",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Career overlap",
    caption = "Active means the player's career overlapped 1994 to 2009."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
